name: Taparia Cross Tip Plus SDS-Plus Hammer Drill Bit (12mm x 160mm)
shortDescription: Industrial SDS-Plus 4-cutter cross tungsten carbide tip hammer bit with reinforced 4-spiral flute for fast, jam-free drilling in reinforced concrete.
overview: The Taparia Cross Tip Plus hammer drill bit is engineered to overcome the common failure mode of conventional 2-cutter bits when encountering steel reinforcement bars (rebar) inside structural concrete. Featuring a robust solid 4-cutter tungsten carbide cross head, it pulverizes hard granite aggregate and slices through embedded rebar without snagging or fracturing. The dynamic 4-spiral turbo flute design channels pulverized dust out of the borehole instantaneously, keeping drilling temperatures low and boosting hole drilling speed by up to 35%.
keyFeatures: Solid 4-cutter cross tungsten carbide tip prevents jamming upon striking rebar
Precision self-centering point ensures exact hole location without wandering
Heavy-duty chrome-molybdenum-nickel alloy steel body resists bending under heavy impact
Optimized 4-spiral flute geometry accelerates dust removal for rapid drilling progress
Standard SDS-Plus shank fits all major rotary hammer machines (Bosch, DeWalt, Hilti, Makita)
High thermal fatigue resistance ensures long bit life in dry continuous drilling
Manufactured to strict PGM (Prüfgemeinschaft Mauerbohrer) dimensional tolerances

specifications.Application Substrates: Reinforced Concrete, Masonry, Granite, Hard Brick

applications: Drilling anchor bolt holes for heavy machinery baseplates
Chemical capsule anchor and mechanical wedge anchor installation
Wall through-holes for electrical conduit and plumbing piping
HVAC duct hanging and false ceiling anchor fixing
